call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guidance maintained at 15% YoY
Zero debt company with capex funded by internal accruals
West Asia crisis impacting exports and raw material costs, with export revenue flat YoY
FY27 revenue growth guided at 15%, maintained despite the West Asia crisis.
Crude-linked raw material costs rose 10% to 50%, a 13% rise in the consumption ratio.
Q1FY27 margin impact seen at about 4%, narrowing over the next three quarters.
FY27 EBITDA margin seen within 1% of 18%, with Valsad insourcing helping offset costs.
Peak revenue from current facilities seen at ₹1,750 Cr, reached over two to three years.
Valsad commissioning slipped from Q4FY26 to Q1FY27; management says it has started.
Own brand sales reached 91% of FY26 revenue, up from 87% in FY25.
Export OEM fell to ₹17 Cr in Q4FY26 from ₹32 Cr a year ago on West Asia disruption.
Analysts pressed on standalone operating profit falling to ₹155 Cr from ₹176 Cr in FY24; management deflected to consolidated mix.
